Talaarawan.description: BINI's first EP explored youth, friendship, love, and personal experiences through a diary-inspired concept. It became a defining release for the group and included some of their most recognized songs.

BINIverse.description: BINIverse expanded BINI's musical direction with a broader pop sound and marked a new phase following the success of Talaarawan.
BINIverse.tagline: A larger world and a wider sound.

Pantropiko.description: Pantropiko became one of BINI's biggest breakout songs and was widely recognized as a summer anthem in the Philippines.

Karera.description: Karera delivered a message about moving at your own pace and resonated strongly with listeners, especially students and younger audiences.
Karera.tagline: No need to rush your timeline.

Salamin, Salamin.description: Salamin, Salamin explored the excitement and uncertainty of attraction through a playful and energetic sound.
